## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated where inference / CLI behavior changes
- [ ] Docs updated if user-facing CLI or APIs change
- [ ] No covert capture / unauthorized-access features
- [ ] Confidence / evidence rules preserved (no invented scores)
- [ ] `go test ./...` (and race/lint if touching parsers or concurrency) passes locally
